body_text:
Everyone in your office is "using AI."

But be honest — you've typed a few prompts into ChatGPT, got generic answers, and went back to doing everything manually.

The problem isn't AI. It's that nobody taught you how to make it work on YOUR job.

That's exactly what the Claude Club Masterclass fixes — a FREE, live, 3-hour hands-on session where you'll build (not watch):

✅ A private AI that knows your role and your documents
✅ Custom Claude Skills for your repeat work — done in one line forever
✅ Claude working inside Gmail, Excel, and your decks
✅ Your first working tool with Claude Code — zero coding needed

Strictly for job professionals & business owners. No students. No theory. No recording — you build it live, in the room.

🎁 Free bonus: The Claude Club Starter Kit — the exact prompts & templates we use.

Seats are limited to keep it hands-on. Register now 👇
title: Free 3-Hour Claude Masterclass — For Job Professionals
